name: PBDW_STAGING_1.V_PBDW_START_DATE_NEW
refresh_sql: CASE WHEN '#PBDW_STAGING_1.V_PBDW_STG2_TABLE_NAME' = 'EOD' THEN (SELECT TO_CHAR(PRIOR_BUSINESS_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM DIM_CONTROL_DATES WHERE LOAD_DATE = (SELECT MAX(LOAD_DATE) FROM DIM_CONTROL_DATES)) ELSE (SELECT TO_CHAR(CURRENT_BUSINESS_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM DIM_CONTROL_DATES WHERE LOAD_DATE = (SELECT MAX(LOAD_DATE) FROM DIM_CONTROL_DATES)) END

name: PBDW_STAGING_1.V_PBDW_END_DATE_NEW
refresh_sql: CASE WHEN '#PBDW_STAGING_1.V_PBDW_STG2_TABLE_NAME' = 'EOD' THEN (SELECT TO_CHAR(PRIOR_BUSINESS_DATE - 1,'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM DIM_CONTROL_DATES WHERE LOAD_DATE = (SELECT MAX(LOAD_DATE) FROM DIM_CONTROL_DATES)) ELSE (SELECT TO_CHAR(CURRENT_BUSINESS_DATE - 1,'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM DIM_CONTROL_DATES WHERE LOAD_DATE = (SELECT MAX(LOAD_DATE) FROM DIM_CONTROL_DATES)) END
